closed_taxonomy.gate-strength: The clause carries decision weight the trader acts on before entry — a hard requirement, a soft/bonus confluence the trader adds, or an either/or route. If a reasonable trader would change their entry decision based on this clause, it has gate-strength.
closed_taxonomy.context: Scene-setting, walkthrough narration of a past example, chart/UI navigation, indicator-setup instructions, or a belief the educator explicitly refutes (refuted strawman). The strategy does not CHECK this clause to decide entry.
closed_taxonomy.cannot-determine: The quote carries no clear modal gate signal either way; the surrounding evidence is insufficient to call gate-strength vs context.

procedure: 1. Adjudicate every item in Set A first, strictly top-to-bottom. Do NOT skip or reorder.
2. STOP after Set A. The verifier applies the control-gate before your target calls count.
3. Then adjudicate Set B1..B14 in listed order, top-to-bottom per section.
4. For each item, choose exactly ONE role from the closed taxonomy and write it to rater_response.role. Optional short justification in rater_response.notes.
5. You adjudicate what role the clause SHOULD carry from the quote alone. You are NOT told what any prior process assigned; there is no 'correct answer' shown to you.

Your target (Set B) calls are COUNTED only if your Set A calls clear >= 4 of 5 in the gate direction AND >= 4 of 5 in the context direction. Which Set A items are gate vs context is NOT disclosed to you.

support_taxonomy.confirmed: The quote fully and faithfully expresses this condition -- a reasonable reader would say the quote IS the trader's own grounding for it.
support_taxonomy.partial: The quote is related to the condition but drifts from it -- captures only part of it, or generalizes/narrows what the trader actually said.
support_taxonomy.denied: The quote does not express this condition at all -- the anchor is mis-grounded.

items.extracted_condition_text: Identify the first 15-minute candle of the trading day and draw a range line at its high and low.
This establishes the structural box for the manipulation candle.
Confirm the 15-minute candle is a manipulation candle by checking if its range is 20 to 25% or more of the Daily ATR.
The ATR threshold confirms the move was aggressive enough to be institutional.
Wait for a reversal candle (Hammer, Inverted Hammer, Bullish Engulfing, or Bearish Engulfing) to appear outside the 15m range.
The reversal candle signals the start of the intended move against the manipulation.
Enter long on the open of the candle following the break above the reversal candle's high.
Enter long on a limit order at the high of the previous red candle (for bullish engulfing).
The engulfing candle provides a high-probability entry at a key reversal level.
The strategy requires the analysis to begin with the first 15-minute candle of the day.
The candle's range must be 20-25% or more of the Daily ATR to confirm manipulation.
High volume above the 20-period MA confirms institutional involvement in the move.
A reversal candle (Hammer/Engulfing) must form outside the 15m range to signal entry.
The stop is placed beyond the low of the reversal candle wick.
The top of the 15m range serves as the primary profit target.
The bottom of the 15m range serves as the primary profit target for short setups.
